justifications.reuse: Good reuse: it reads through eqdsk's EQDSKInterface rather than writing a G-EQDSK reader, returns the existing EfitLabels record the convention kernel already consumes, and feeds the row through the existing read_signal_map_observation and cohort scorer with no parallel scorer. justifications.scope_discipline: Exactly the six declared repo paths (two source, two test, two fragments) plus the node's own run directory; the diff names nothing else and the worktree is clean at head. The corpus copy to /work/projects/imas_gpu/jt60sa/101011.geqdsk is the write the plan's psi-row paragraph directs. No plan/index/sprint mutation.
